description.value: Big Bang Sushi is a Japanese restaurant established in 2016 on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from the Stanley Park Seawall — one of the city's most popular cycling corridors. The menu spans sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, udon, and tempura, with both dine-in and online carryout ordering available. A second location operates in Richmond, but the Denman Street shop is the one most relevant to cyclists touring the seawall or West End.

The order-online subpage explicitly supports carryout at 1103 Denman Street, confirming takeout availability. The menu lists a dedicated VEGETARIAN category; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Website lists a second location in Richmond (#1118 - 13351 Commerce Parkway); the OSM record covers only the Denman Street (Downtown) location — no duplication issue, but worth noting if a separate Richmond OSM record exists.
